tools.title: Embeddings Comparison
tools.description: Map embeddings of raw gene expression files using the Gen3 Embedding Service's similarity search to find each sample's nearest neighbors across all TCGA cancer types.

tools.title: Embedding-based Lung Cancer Classification
tools.description: Explore two ways to use embeddings to classify non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) subtypes, specifically lung adenocarcinoma vs lung squamous cell carcinoma.

tools.title: Multimodal Cancer Modeling in the Age of Foundation Model Embeddings
tools.description: Investigate the ability to train classical machine learning models over multimodal, zero-shot FM embeddings of cancer data
